description: six separate fantasy forest objects: a giant red spotted mushroom, a cluster of glowing blue mushrooms, a purple crystal cluster growing out of a rock, a bush of colourful magic flowers, a glowing blue rune stone, a ring of small red mushrooms. for a top-down 3/4 view fantasy action RPG, seen from above at an angle, soft shading lit from the upper left, a thin dark outline, rich natural colours, detailed modern pixel art. These are SEPARATE GAME SPRITES, ISOLATED objects only: no scene, no forest, no ground, no floor tiles, no grass bases or platforms under them, no shadows on a floor. Arranged in a 3 by 2 grid with wide empty space between them, every object whole, not touching the others or the picture edges, on a plain flat pure white background that fills the whole picture
